bytes_rate_derivation: mean of all succeeded absolute records, tokens / recorded prefill or decode phase duration
disk_derivation: sum stat.st_size of every regular file in each uncompressed pilot-1 bundle (inventory recorded); OLS bytes ~ 1 + member_s
factor_derivation: last long-cell repeat final turn / first long-cell repeat initial turn; includes thermal slowdown

state_observation_cost.derivation: 100 paired hash observations per environment, sum of perf_counter_ns time around before/after hashes only; call excluded
state_observation_cost.scope: offline real SHADE environments; agent-active timings, no MLX model or hardware capture

tool_derivation: sum phase/align_tool_* durations per recorded turn; maximum observed turn, transferred as planning
